compensating.why: odd sibling treats a NaN total as empty

ownership_reason: Only the per-column totals inspect individual values; once a NaN has entered a total no later hop can recover the finite total (the facade, fold and extent hops see only the sums). The project's stacking code skips NaN everywhere else (StackedAreaRenderer.getStackValues, the TableXYDataset overload, StackedBarRenderer3D's two strict tests) and the trigger adds Double.NaN expecting the range to stay [2, 8].
